question: district wise 2023 employment outcome rate, worst first
gold_sql: SELECT district, ROUND(100.0 * employed_at_6_months / women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY employment_percent ASC, district
sql_duckdb: SELECT T2.district, CAST(T2.employed_at_6_months AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(NULLIF(T2.women_enrolled, 0), 0) AS employment_outcome_rate FROM livelihoods AS T1 INNER JOIN "livelihoods" AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2023 ORDER BY employment_outcome_rate ASC NULLS FIRST
